She discovers that the White Tower was the nerve centre of Henry's military and some of the Mary Rose's arsenal of weapons may have been supplied from the fortress. In Portsmouth, Tracy is granted rare access to the remains of the ship and sees for herself what Henry VIII's favourite warship looked like up close. Yeoman Warder Mark Anderson discovers a piece of Tower history hidden in plain sight - a wooden boat hook used to pull dead bodies from the Thames. And preparations are made for the Tower's commemorations for VJ Day, or Victory over Japan Day. Exec Prod: Sarah Sarkhel; Series Prods: Simon Smith/Lauren Bennie; Dir: Chris Barham; Lion Television (S9 Ep5)
People work together to keep the famed Tower of London running smoothly.
